summary_en: 1,000,000 ordinary shares cancelled (1.92% of shares outstanding). Effective date 31 Aug 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 51,056,530. Treasury shares after cancellation: 3,609,627.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: F.C.C Co., Ltd. (ticker 7296, TSE Prime) completed the cancellation of 1,000,000 ordinary treasury shares on 31 August 2026, pursuant to the Companies Act Article 178. The cancelled shares represent 1.92% of the 52,056,530 issued shares outstanding at the time of cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's issued share count decreased to 51,056,530 shares, with 3,609,627 treasury shares remaining on the balance sheet. The cancellation was previously announced on 11 June 2026.
